verdict.rationale: The evidence shows first-party integration surfaces: an official Claude Code plugin, a hosted MCP server, a scriptable `poly` CLI, and a `poly-cli` agent skill. None of these is a documented extension API or SDK for building your own plugins, and no developer samples or plugin-authoring docs appear. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a documented plugin-building interface.
